alpha_only_parameter_search.protocol: Train 30 constant 1-degree, 12-second episodes. Retain last actor, critic, identifier and learning-rate schedules. Evaluate independent copies with online updates, step at 2 seconds, dt=0.01 s. Static accuracy uses the final 10 percent mean; benchmark convention is separately retained.
limitations: The selected seed-0 positive unit-step passes the four post-step conditions, but not the complete-reference zero-hold accuracy.
Pre-step alpha reaches 0.09115 degrees at zero command. The 0.5, 2 and -1 degree steps do not meet the 1 percent tail-error criterion.
Seed 1 retains approximately 0.393 degrees of unit-step error; seed 2 exceeds the diagnostic alpha envelope during final step evaluation after 30 completed training episodes.
CPI 2.02078 is higher than the former two-error baseline CPI 0.67219. The static-error improvement is not an overall CPI improvement.
The 500-second run is a numerical fixed-linearization stress test; sustained pitch rate accumulates pitch angle. It does not validate nonlinear flight physics.
The very small derivative-loss ratio approaches the HDP limit; the result does not demonstrate an advantage of a large GDHP costate contribution.
